'''Brin Vimdin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] son of [[Bom Vimdin/Legends|Bom Vindim]], who became an exceptional [[pilot]] and an agent of the Advozsec resistance against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. He was one of [[Zsall Dubrotin]]'s most trusted agents.<ref name="GMR" />
